items.title: File Widerspruch against rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Versandtag (dispatch day) stated as Samstag, 21.11.2026. The letter itself fixes Bekanntgabe (deemed notice) as the 4th day after the dispatch day: counting 22.11 (day1), 23.11 (day2), 24.11 (day3), 25.11 (day4) → Bekanntgabe = Wednesday, 25.11.2026 (this is not a Sat/Sun/holiday, so no shift needed; note this 4-day rule deviates from the standard 3-day fiction of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the event day (25.11.2026) is not counted; the one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG, § 36a SGB I) therefore starts 26.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the event day, i.e. 25.12.2026. However 25.12.2026 (1. Weihnachtstag) is a statutory holiday in NW; the next days 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag, also a Saturday) and 27.12.2026 (Sunday) are also non-working. Per § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, which is Monday, 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states the Bescheid is deemed delivered on the 4th day after dispatch, but the standard statutory fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X for social-insurance notices is 3 days after dispatch; if the actual rule applicable to this provider is 3 days instead of 4, the Widerspruchsfrist would run from 24.11.2026 and end on 24.12.2026 (shifted, since Dec 25-27 are non-working, to Monday 28.12.2026 as well in this case) — double-check which rule actually applies to be safe, though in this instance both readings converge on the same final date.
